messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Private cluster 'acme-retail-eu' GPU queue length exceeded threshold (90th pct queue depth = 36, threshold=20). Autoscaler attempted 6 provisions in last 5m; 4 in 'PendingImagePull' and 2 in 'NotReady'.
Devon: paging oncall. I'm taking it.
Maya: oncall here, looking. any customer impact?
incident-bot: Impact: ~25% of inference requests are queued > 2s; ~4% 503 errors reported by edge routers. Ticket created: INC-37245.
Devon: logs show a lot of nodes stuck in ImagePullBackOff. Registry is internal private mirror. Could be auth or rate limit.
Maya: kubectl get pods -n acme-gpu -o wide | grep ImagePullBackOff -> multiple bootstrapper pods stuck.
Maya: running: kubectl describe pod acme-gpu-provisioner-7f9d | sed -n '1,140p'
Maya: ```
Events:
  Normal  Scheduled  3m   default-scheduler  Successfully assigned acme-gpu-provisioner-7f9d to node-pool-provisioner-1
  Warning BackOff     2m   kubelet            Back-off pulling image "private-registry.acme/cuda-runtime:11-locked"
  Warning Failed      2m   kubelet            Error: ImagePullBackOff
```
Sahil: I can confirm the registry returned 401 for several pulls earlier, then a 429 burst.
Devon: any recent creds rotation or cert rollover for that customer?
Jia (CS): Customer says they rotated their mirror token 08:45 UTC for compliance. We were not notified. They use their own mirror inside customer VPC.
Maya: That explains the 401. Autoscaler keeps trying to create nodes but they can't finish bootstrap -> scale loop and queue growth.
Kevin: We have a mitigation path: 1) temporarily route traffic for acme-retail to hosted fallback pool (lower throughput but keeps requests serving), 2) evict low-priority background jobs on their cluster to free existing GPU slots, 3) ask customer to re-provide the mirror token.
Devon: Agree. Maya, can you kick the routing change? I'll coordinate CS with customer.
Maya: running config change now. command: ``redwoodctl route update --customer acme-retail --route inference --to hosted-fallback-eu --concurrency 20``
Maya: Applied. DNS/route propagation ~30s.
ops-alerts: routing update: acme-retail inference traffic: 65% -> private cluster, 35% -> hosted-fallback-eu (gradual shift)
Sahil: Evicting non-critical jobs: ``kubectl -n acme-gpu delete job --selector=priority=low`` Doing dry-run first.
Devon: @Jia keep customer posted: ask them to re-issue mirror token and give us an IAM role to rotate if needed. Also we need an ETA for token refresh.
Jia (CS): Messaged customer. They replied: 'token rotation in progress, will push new token in ~12 mins and confirm.'
Maya: Watch on node status: provisioning still shows 3 nodes PendingImagePull. If token rotates and pulls succeed we'll see them Ready within ~90s after pull completes.
incident-bot: Metrics update (5m): queue depth dropping from 36 -> 18 after routing change; 503s down to 1.2% from 4%.
Kevin: Good. Keep routing partial so we don't overload hosted pool. Also enable auto-fallback policy in case private cluster flaps.
Devon: Documenting runbook steps in INC-37245. I'll add timeline and mitigation actions.
Sahil: Image pulls succeeded for one node at 3724501255; node became Ready at 3724501310.
Maya: Confirmed 2 more nodes pulled successfully after token update. PendingImagePull -> Ready.
incident-bot: Update: autoscaler performed 3 successful provisions. Queue depth now 9. Latency normalized for 90% requests.
Jia (CS): Customer confirms token rotated and apologizes for not sending a heads up. They've requested a postmortem and a short blameless timeline.
Devon: We'll prepare postmortem. Immediate action: keep routing 30% to fallback for 20 minutes to be safe. Maya please monitor for 1hr and then we can start draining hosted fallback if stable.
Maya: Ack. I'll leave verbose logging on: ``kubectl logs -n acme-gpu --selector=app=bootstrapper --since=10m`` and watch autoscaler events.
Kevin: Follow-ups: 1) Add registry-credential-change webhook to customer runbook so CS gets notified. 2) Add autoscaler backoff cap to avoid repeated provisions when image pulls repeatedly fail (exponential backoff).
Sahil: Also consider pre-warming with scratch nodes that have image cached for heavy customers.
Devon: Oncall handoff in 45m to night team. For now I'm going to close pager escalation. Thanks all.
Maya: :thumbsup: stacking tickets: INC-37245 (active), PM-37245 (postmortem).
incident-bot: Pager closed by Devon at 3724501350.
Kevin: Great work. We'll do a 30min retrofit meeting 1h from now with infra and CS. :pray:
